title: Enterprise Connectivity: review price reduction
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this review price reduction rule to corrected monthly transfer assessment.

## Basis: reduction
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, the assisted review reduction is the smaller of the Network tier portfolio reduction fraction and the matching Support fraction; it replaces other portfolio and promotion reductions for this review, and is zero for approved negotiated pricing.

## Basis Q&A
| Corrected monthly transfer assessment basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Corrected monthly transfer assessment: The assisted review reduction is the smaller of the Network tier portfolio reduction fraction and the matching Support fraction | it replaces other portfolio and promotion reductions for this review, and is zero for approved negotiated pricing. |

## Hypothetical branch comparison
With hypothetical Network and matching Support fractions of 0.04 and 0.06, the review reduction is 0.04. Approved negotiated pricing makes it zero, regardless of those hypothetical fractions.
